# Short playback regression clips

Three synthetic `testsrc2` clips, each 1 second, 96×64, 12 frames, yuv420p.
No downloaded or private media. Every clip has a committed raw YUV pixel oracle
(110,592 bytes) decoded independently by FFmpeg.

- `avc-baseline.mp4`: H.264 Baseline, CAVLC, I/P frames, GOP 4.
- `avc-bframes.mp4`: H.264 High, CABAC, up to two B-frames, GOP 4.
- `vp9-motion.webm`: VP9 motion, GOP 4, no alternate-reference frames.

`tests/short_video_samples.rs` runs native software decode against every oracle
pixel, checks frame count, EOF and increasing presentation timestamps, repeats
after rewind, and checks seeks at 0, 250, 600 and 900 ms against sequential output.
These tests run with ordinary `cargo test`; no network, FFmpeg or hardware decoder
is needed during the test run.

Focused run:

```sh
cargo test --locked --no-default-features --test short_video_samples
```

Regenerate clips and oracles (requires FFmpeg with libx264 and libvpx-vp9):

```sh
python3 scripts/generate_short_video_samples.py
```

Encoder versions can change generated bytes; review regenerated oracles and run
the tests before replacing committed files.
